sql: WITH despesa_saude AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS total_despesa FROM saude_saude WHERE ano_referencia = 2024), receita_impostos_transfer AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS total_receita FROM receita_receita WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 AND (dsc_especie ILIKE '%Imposto%' OR dsc_origem ILIKE '%Transfer%')) SELECT (total_despesa / NULLIF(total_receita, 0)) * 100 AS ies_c FROM despesa_saude, receita_impostos_transfer;
